Ah, it's 11.16pm. Time for bed. But no! Troll brain thinks it's time to ruminate on my feedback session tomorrow. Anxiety intensifies. Overthinking commences.
Wish I could clear my diary today. I feel tired and mentally drained.
I've been involved in a few conversations recently about resilience and I find much of it infuriating. Why do we ask so much of people who are already demotivated, demoralesed, anxious, stressed?
trapped in negative thought patterns, compounded by stress!
Everything makes me cry these days.

I've been wanting to write a new blog/journal about my mental health during the time of #coronavirus but to be honest the motivation is there some days and not others. Ironic! This is life with depression - some days you're hyped, some days it's an effort to blink.
